benchmarkDenominator.warning: The denominator is counted from cloned upstream sources, but parity is still partial. Native PHP tests map hashing/key behavior, focused in-memory sparse tree update/get/delete scenarios, iterator lower/upper-bound windows, compact proof encoding/decoding, selected proof import/export, integer proof sizing, and range proofs. PHP roots/proofs currently use the lane HashTree SHA-256 surrogate because this PHP build lacks BLAKE2s.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native hash/key primitives plus in-memory sparse tree get/put/delete, update batching, path-independent roots, getMulti, empty-head restoration, delete bubbling equivalence, raw-key iterator windows, compact proof transport encoding/decoding, selected proof import/export, proof-size checks, and raw-key range proofs.

wordpressScenario: Authenticated local-first state sync for Playground snapshots and content databases; current fixtures/examples map ordered WordPress option/post records through raw integer keys, iterator windows, and compact authenticated range proofs.
nextTask: Port proof-backed update/merge semantics from the upstream update proof scenarios, including witness-leaf mutation guards and partial-tree mergeProof expansion.
